clause: Selection refinement ops + unified refine-edge / select-and-mask surface [STU-RAS-020]

scope.summary: Implement selection-refinement commands on StudioSelectionSet: Grow/Shrink (radius, circular option), Feather (radius), Smooth (radius), Border, Expand/Contract. Provide ONE unified edge-refinement surface (refine-edge / select-and-mask) with matte/edge refinement for hair/fine detail (border width, smooth, feather, ramp), a refinement adjustment brush (matte/foreground/background/feather modes), preview modes (overlay/black matte/white matte/black-and-white/transparent), and output routing to Selection, Mask, New Layer, or New Layer With Mask.
acceptance_criteria: one refine-edge surface with brush, preview modes, and 4 output routes
proof_targets: refine-edge hair extraction + output-routing runtime + preview snapshot
expected_tests: live: grow/shrink/feather/smooth/border modify the selection by radius; refine-edge extracts hair against contrast with the refinement brush
live: output routing produces each of Selection/Mask/New Layer/New Layer With Mask

risk_if_missed: No edge refinement; hair/fine-detail cutouts impossible; refine-edge and refine-selection not deduped.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
